candidate.source: functionally retained candidate supplied to the downstream agent

parameters.$candidate_bit: the selected bit of the bound candidate
parameters.$scenario_security_window: scenario-defined event or bounded timing parameter

feature_contract.provenance: independent threat definition and RTL semantics; no downstream implementation or result input
feature_contract.trial_parameter_policy: candidate bits, legal values, seeds, repetitions, and bounded timing sweeps are inferred and recorded before simulation; they do not create additional semantic scenarios
feature_contract.definition: Measure the candidate-bit fraction of valid perturbation opportunities that converts a baseline-denied protected operation into an effective access or write.
feature_contract.execution_model: paired secure-baseline and candidate-perturbed executions from the same legal state
feature_contract.calculation: maximum candidate-bit deny-to-accept fraction over applicable legal scenarios
validity_policy: candidate and decision observations are known

classification.bypass: candidate mutation changes DENY to an effective protected action
classification.not_applicable: scenario is outside the candidate's declared scope
classification.invalid: setup, denial, pairing, activation, or knownness requirement fails

applicability.candidate_scope: candidate with a legal RTL path for this scenario

observations.purpose: distinguish secure denial from effective acceptance

validity: scenario-specific legal protected-operation setup and denial anchor are reached
